A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same FRIGID research work. All 22 pages of each version, including Appendices A-C, figures, tables, and equations, are available and support a complete comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original FRIGID experiments on NPLIB1 and MassSpecGym, computational measurements, scaling studies, ablations, robustness analyses, and prediction examples.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results in Section 5 and Appendices A-C, including benchmark performance and supplementary analyses.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1 and B.1 revise the reported 12-layer backbone from hidden size 768 with 12 attention heads to 896 with 14 heads. This is a limited architectural configuration revision; conditioning, training objectives, length prediction, and ICEBERG-guided refinement remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same SAFE-GPT pretraining corpus and NPLIB1 and MassSpecGym benchmarks. Appendix scenarios involving uncertain formulae, fingerprint quality, direct spectra conditioning, and dataset overlap are also retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding experiments, including DiffMS, MADGEN, MS-BART, fingerprint-decoder baselines, and FOAM on MassSpecGym. The naive-scaling comparisons and corrected versus inflated MIST + MolForge comparison already appear in v1.

E3.justification: Section 3.2's footnote changes the reference split for calibrating the unchanged 0.187 fingerprint threshold from training to validation. The backbone dimensions and reported model size also change, including 182.2M to 247.0M parameters for Table 13's 1B-structure run. These are revised stated settings; the PDFs do not establish that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The same refinement ablations, hyperparameter sensitivity tests, MolForge bug analysis, formula and fingerprint robustness analyses, direct-conditioning ablation, overlap analysis, and prediction case studies remain. No new analysis outcomes are added; Table 13's model-size amendment concerns the reported setting.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. No repeated-run counts, seed information, uncertainty estimation, confidence intervals, or significance tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: The reported model-complexity number changes from 182.2M to 247.0M parameters in Table 2 and Table 13's 1B row. Accuracy, MCES, Tanimoto, runtime, training GPU hours, and qualitative predictions remain unchanged; Table 1 still reports FRIGID Top-1 accuracies of 25.03% and 18.29% on NPLIB1 and MassSpecGym.

T1.justification: The conditional-generation formulation, diffusion objective, atom-consistency scoring, and masking definitions in Equations 1-6 are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about diffusion-based structural elucidation, scalable pretraining, targeted inference-time refinement, benchmark performance, and inference speed. The revised model specifications do not redefine these claims.

C2.justification: Scaling and efficiency interpretations, robustness conclusions, the lack of a SAFE-versus-SMILES ablation, and Appendix C's failure-mode discussion remain unchanged. The interpretation of training scaling is not qualified following the largest model's parameter-count revision.

D1.justification: Reproducibility specifications are revised: hidden width, attention-head count, parameter counts, and the split used for fingerprint-threshold calibration. Optimizer settings, training budgets, hardware, decoding details, and code/model access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, Section 2's research positioning, novelty statements, and explanations of baseline inclusion or exclusion are unchanged. The new proceedings notice is publication metadata, not revised positioning relative to prior research.

P1.justification: The first-page preprint notice becomes an ICML 2026 proceedings notice, the arXiv version/date stamp changes, and the abstract's code-link sentence gains terminal punctuation. Apart from localized specification edits, the prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 1 removes the erroneous second-best underline from FRIGID-base's MassSpecGym Top-10 MCES value of 11.95, without changing the value. First-page footer spacing also changes. Figures, table structures, captions, and their placement otherwise remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: Correcting Table 1's misleading highlight is beneficial, and the revised specifications may improve reproducibility. However, unlike v1, v2 lists 247.0M parameters for Table 13's largest run while retaining a caption claiming constant parameter counts for the larger pretraining sets. The PDFs do not explain whether the specification revisions correct earlier reporting or describe changed runs. This unresolved inconsistency in the scaling evidence prevents a reliable net quality judgment.
